title: Revit Phase and Design Option Control Fields

entries.name: View purpose
entries.requirement: Each governed phase/design-option display rule shall identify the view purpose to which the rule applies.

entries.name: Project phase identity
entries.requirement: Where phase state is material, the governed rule shall identify the project phase or reference the governed project phase configuration; source example phase names shall not become enterprise defaults by migration alone.

entries.name: Phase-filter identity
entries.requirement: Where phase display is material, the governed rule shall identify the phase-filter basis or reference the governed project configuration that defines it.

entries.name: Phase display intent
entries.requirement: The rule shall state the intended treatment of existing, demolished, new, temporary, or other project-defined phase states sufficiently to verify the declared view purpose.

entries.name: Template control basis
entries.requirement: Recurring phase and option visibility shall be controlled through the approved view-template or governed mapping where feasible rather than repeated ad-hoc per-view settings.

entries.name: Design Option visibility mode
entries.requirement: Where Design Options are used, each governed view shall identify whether it inherits the governed primary option or uses an explicit view-specific option display basis.

entries.name: Option-set identity
entries.requirement: When a view-specific Design Option is required, the applicable project option set shall be identified explicitly.

entries.name: Option identity
entries.requirement: When a view-specific Design Option is required, the applicable option shall be identified explicitly and shall not be inferred from a local naming convention alone.

entries.name: Primary-option basis
entries.requirement: Primary-option selection is project-governed data. No discipline-specific primary option shall be assumed unless the applicable project configuration or approval record defines it.

entries.name: Graphics interaction
entries.requirement: Where phase filters or Design Options alter visibility or graphics, the resulting display shall remain consistent with the governed view purpose, graphics standards, and documented legend/communication intent.

entries.name: Exception trace
entries.requirement: Any material view-specific departure from the governed phase or option display basis shall record the rationale and approval trace.

non_promoted_source_content: Existing, Demolition, New Construction, Show Previous + Demo, Show Demo + New, and Show New + Existing are source examples and are not promoted as a universal enterprise phase/filter vocabulary.
The source explicitly leaves default primary Design Options per discipline unresolved; Round 005 does not invent those defaults.
No universal phase sequence, option-set taxonomy, option naming syntax, or project workset/option combination is created here.

source_titles: Category & Subcategory Graphics Standards and Guidelines
provenance.migration_note: Round 005 makes the source-backed phase and Design Option control dimensions machine-readable while preserving phase names, filter names, option sets, primary options, and discipline defaults as project-specific unless separately governed.
